interface.shortDescription: Self-hosted Codex CLI marketplace for x_likes_downloader.
interface.longDescription: Provides a Codex CLI plugin (x_likes) that lets the user operate their own X (Twitter) Likes feed via natural language — list likes, download attached media, and verify cookie health. Backed by a local x_likes_downloader MCP server. Credentials never leave the user's machine.

plugins.name: x_likes
plugins.description: Operate your own X likes via natural language. Uses a SKILL.md + MCP server combo; LLM dispatches list_likes / download_media / auth_status / setup_from_curl based on intent.
